# Slipway

> Your agentic development environment as code. One command installs and updates agent skills (pinned by commit),
> coding agents (omp, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor), omp model routing, Beads task tracking and OpenSpec, and
> sets up repositories for a spec-to-PR delivery flow.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): install, packs, commands, FAQ
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): manifest, profiles, local overlay, lock, state
- [Design doc](docs/design.md): architecture, ownership rules, risks

## Reference

- [Skills catalogue](docs/skills.md): every skill installed and why
- [Harnesses and routing](docs/harnesses.md): role → harness → model, multi-harness path, Jev
- [Decisions](docs/adr/README.md)
- [Comparison](docs/comparison.md): versus earlier approaches and other tools
- [Agent rules](config/global-rules.md): the block Slipway writes into each harness's instructions
